cases.name: report nvarchar document
cases.query:
DECLARE @d NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'{"a":1,"b":null}';
SELECT j.[key], ISNULL(j.[value], N''), COALESCE(j.[value], N'x'), IIF(j.[value] IS NULL, N'n', j.[value]), CASE WHEN j.[value] = N'1' THEN 1 END FROM OPENJSON(@d) j ORDER BY j.[key];

SELECT j.[key], ISNULL(j.[value], N''), COALESCE(j.[value], N'x'), IIF(j.[value] IS NULL, N'n', j.[value]), CASE WHEN j.[value] = N'1' THEN 1 END FROM OPENJSON(@d) j ORDER BY j.[key];

cases.name: report literal document
cases.query: SELECT j.[key], ISNULL(j.[value], N''), COALESCE(j.[value], N'x'), IIF(j.[value] IS NULL, N'n', j.[value]), CASE WHEN j.[value] = N'1' THEN 1 END FROM OPENJSON(N'{"a":1,"b":null}') j ORDER BY j.[key];

cases.name: isnull key and value types
cases.query: DECLARE @d NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'{"a":1,"b":null,"c":"x ","d":"\ud83e\udd86","e":[1,2],"f":true,"g":""}'; SELECT j.[key], ISNULL(j.[key], N'k') AS k, ISNULL(j.[value], N'') AS v, ISNULL(j.[value], 'ansi') AS va, ISNULL(j.[type], 0) AS t, LEN(ISNULL(j.[value], N'')) AS n, DATALENGTH(ISNULL(j.[value], N'')) AS b FROM OPENJSON(@d) j ORDER BY j.[key];

cases.name: coalesce mixes
cases.query: DECLARE @d NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'{"a":1,"b":null,"c":"x ","d":"\ud83e\udd86","e":[1,2],"f":true,"g":""}'; SELECT j.[key], COALESCE(j.[value], j.[key]) AS vk, COALESCE(j.[value], 'ansi') AS va, COALESCE(j.[value], NULL, N'z') AS vz, COALESCE(NULL, j.[value]) AS nv FROM OPENJSON(@d) j ORDER BY j.[key];

cases.name: carrier as replacement
cases.query: DECLARE @d NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'{"a":1,"b":null,"c":"x ","d":"\ud83e\udd86","e":[1,2],"f":true,"g":""}'; DECLARE @a VARCHAR(10) = NULL, @n NVARCHAR(10) = NULL; SELECT j.[key], ISNULL(@n, j.[value]) AS nv, ISNULL(@a, j.[value]) AS av, ISNULL(@n, j.[key]) AS nk FROM OPENJSON(@d) j ORDER BY j.[key];

cases.name: iif and case
cases.query: DECLARE @d NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'{"a":1,"b":null,"c":"x ","d":"\ud83e\udd86","e":[1,2],"f":true,"g":""}'; SELECT j.[key], IIF(j.[value] IS NULL, N'n', j.[value]) AS i1, IIF(j.[type] = 2, j.[value], 'other') AS i2, CASE WHEN j.[type] = 0 THEN NULL ELSE j.[value] END AS c3 FROM OPENJSON(@d) j ORDER BY j.[key];

cases.name: case comparisons
cases.query: DECLARE @d NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'{"a":1,"b":null,"c":"x ","f":true,"g":"","h":"m"}'; SELECT j.[key], CASE j.[value] WHEN N'1' THEN N'one' WHEN N'x' THEN N'ex' ELSE j.[key] END AS c1, CASE WHEN j.[value] = N'x' THEN 1 WHEN j.[value] > N'l' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS c2 FROM OPENJSON(@d) j ORDER BY j.[key];

cases.name: isnull in predicates and ordering
cases.query: DECLARE @d NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'{"a":1,"b":null,"c":"x ","f":true,"g":"","h":"m"}'; SELECT j.[key] FROM OPENJSON(@d) j WHERE ISNULL(j.[value], N'') <> N'' AND ISNULL(j.[value], N'') <> N'x' ORDER BY ISNULL(j.[value], N'') DESC, j.[key];

cases.name: comparison with literal
cases.query: DECLARE @d NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'{"a":1,"b":null,"c":"x ","f":true,"g":"","h":"m"}'; SELECT j.[key] FROM OPENJSON(@d) j WHERE j.[value] = N'x' OR j.[value] = '1' OR j.[value] IN (N'true', N'') ORDER BY j.[key];

cases.name: explicit schema
cases.query: DECLARE @d NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'{"a":1,"b":null,"c":"x ","d":"\ud83e\udd86","e":[1,2],"f":true,"g":""}'; SELECT ISNULL(w.a, N'') AS a, ISNULL(w.b, N'nb') AS b, COALESCE(w.c, 'cc') AS c, IIF(w.b IS NULL, N'n', w.b) AS i, CASE WHEN w.c = N'x' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS e, ISNULL(w.e, N'[]') AS j FROM OPENJSON(@d) WITH (a NVARCHAR(10) '$.a', b NVARCHAR(MAX) '$.b', c VARCHAR(10) '$.c', e NVARCHAR(MAX) '$.e' AS JSON) w;

cases.name: explicit schema varchar document
cases.query: DECLARE @d VARCHAR(MAX) = '{"a":"p","b":null}'; SELECT ISNULL(w.a, N'') AS a, ISNULL(w.b, 'nb') AS b, COALESCE(w.b, w.a) AS c FROM OPENJSON(@d) WITH (a NVARCHAR(10), b VARCHAR(5)) w;

cases.name: two sources full join
cases.query: SELECT i.id, x.k, x.l, x.r FROM items i CROSS APPLY (SELECT COALESCE(l.[key], r.[key]) AS k, l.[value] AS l, r.[value] AS r FROM OPENJSON(i.lhs) l FULL JOIN OPENJSON(i.rhs) r ON l.[key] = r.[key] WHERE ISNULL(l.[value], N'') <> ISNULL(r.[value], N'')) x ORDER BY i.id, x.k;

cases.name: two sources through function
setup: CREATE FUNCTION dbo.foo(@lhs NVARCHAR(MAX), @rhs NVARCHAR(MAX)) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN (SELECT COALESCE(l.[key], r.[key]) AS [key], l.[value] AS old_value, r.[value] AS new_value FROM OPENJSON(@lhs) l FULL OUTER JOIN OPENJSON(@rhs) r ON l.[key] = r.[key]);
cases.query: SELECT i.id, x.[key], x.old_value, x.new_value, ISNULL(x.old_value, N'-') AS o, COALESCE(x.new_value, N'-') AS n FROM items i OUTER APPLY dbo.foo(i.lhs, i.rhs) x WHERE ISNULL(x.old_value, N'') <> ISNULL(x.new_value, N'') ORDER BY i.id, x.[key];

cases.name: trigger diff of json snapshots
setup: CREATE FUNCTION dbo.foo(@lhs NVARCHAR(MAX), @rhs NVARCHAR(MAX)) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN (SELECT COALESCE(l.[key], r.[key]) AS [key], l.[value] AS old_value, r.[value] AS new_value FROM OPENJSON(@lhs) l FULL OUTER JOIN OPENJSON(@rhs) r ON l.[key] = r.[key]);

CREATE TRIGGER docs_audit ON docs AFTER UPDATE AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;
  INSERT INTO audit(id, [key], old_value, new_value)
  SELECT i.id, x.[key], x.old_value, x.new_value
  FROM inserted i
  JOIN deleted d ON d.id = i.id
  CROSS APPLY dbo.foo(
    (SELECT d.name, d.qty, d.note FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER),
    (SELECT i.name, i.qty, i.note FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER)) x
  WHERE ISNULL(x.old_value, N'') <> ISNULL(x.new_value, N'');
END
cases.query: UPDATE docs SET qty = qty + 1, note = CASE id WHEN 2 THEN NULL WHEN 4 THEN N'w' ELSE N'z' END WHERE id IN (1, 2, 4); SELECT id, [key], old_value, new_value FROM audit ORDER BY id, [key];

cases.name: trigger with unchanged rows
setup: CREATE FUNCTION dbo.foo(@lhs NVARCHAR(MAX), @rhs NVARCHAR(MAX)) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN (SELECT COALESCE(l.[key], r.[key]) AS [key], l.[value] AS old_value, r.[value] AS new_value FROM OPENJSON(@lhs) l FULL OUTER JOIN OPENJSON(@rhs) r ON l.[key] = r.[key]);

CREATE TRIGGER docs_audit ON docs AFTER UPDATE AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;
  INSERT INTO audit(id, [key], old_value, new_value)
  SELECT i.id, x.[key], x.old_value, x.new_value
  FROM inserted i
  JOIN deleted d ON d.id = i.id
  CROSS APPLY dbo.foo(
    (SELECT d.name, d.qty, d.note FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER),
    (SELECT i.name, i.qty, i.note FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER)) x
  WHERE ISNULL(x.old_value, N'') <> ISNULL(x.new_value, N'');
END
cases.query: UPDATE docs SET name = name; SELECT id, [key], old_value, new_value FROM audit ORDER BY id, [key];

cases.name: concat isnull string_agg nvarchar
cases.query: SELECT N'text' + ISNULL((SELECT STRING_AGG(v, N',') FROM (VALUES (N'a'),(N'b')) t(v)), N'') AS s;

cases.name: concat isnull string_agg varchar
cases.query: SELECT 'text' + ISNULL((SELECT STRING_AGG(v, ',') FROM (VALUES ('a'),('b')) t(v)), '') AS s;

cases.name: concat isnull aggregate subquery
cases.query: SELECT N'text' + ISNULL((SELECT MAX(v) FROM (VALUES (N'a'),(N'b')) t(v)), N'') AS s, ISNULL((SELECT MIN(v) FROM (VALUES (N'abc')) t(v)), N'') AS m, CASE WHEN ISNULL((SELECT MAX(v) FROM (VALUES (N'a')) t(v)), N'') = N'a' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS e;

cases.name: isnull stored unicode widths
setup: CREATE TABLE tn(n NVARCHAR(3) NULL, c NCHAR(3) NULL); INSERT INTO tn VALUES (NULL, NULL), (N'ab', N'ab');
cases.query: SELECT ISNULL(n, N'xyzw') AS a, ISNULL(c, N'q') AS b, N'<' + ISNULL(n, N'') + N'>' AS d, ISNULL((SELECT STRING_AGG(n, N',') FROM tn), N'') AS e FROM tn ORDER BY n;
